name: University of York online PhD in computer science (formal methods)

mentions.name: University of York online PhD in computer science (formal methods)
mentions.description: An online PhD in computer science focused on formal methods at the University of York that the author was enrolled in; they found it pretty great, but it cost roughly $17,000 per year and was a huge time sink on top of full-time work, so they dropped it.
mentions.problem: Costing around $17,000 per year and consuming large amounts of time while already working full time.
mentions.source_excerpt: I was doing the University of York online PhD in computer science (formal methods), and it was actually pretty great, but it was costing me like $17,000 per year, and it was a huge time sink when I was already working full time.
